head: 82cb2a3acccc852bba6a7ef9c706c337ba9fe765
status: Additional connected source follow-through; P06 remains uncommitted, uncompiled, unvalidated and without two full Code/Rule passes.

changes.trace: Checked building placement centre and collision PlanExtents now remain checked through retained obstacle reservations and apron containment. Plot centre and PlanDimensions use their canonical owners; PlanDimensions::half_extents returns PlanExtents directly.
changes.native_boundary: The final scene-to-local rotation, half-extent expansion and comparison project metres. Raw serialized u16 obstacle ordinals are decoded once, preserving multiply-then-subtract order, before containment.
changes.state_and_failure: Unused elevation fields and the fake zero reservation floor are removed. The geographical caller always supplied an empty grading-pad slice; that dead branch/parameter and unused pad methods are removed without a forwarding API. Terrain validation follows grade repair. Obstacle filtering prepares a complete retained vector before mutation/count publication and propagates GeometryError through SceneInputError.
risks: The reservation envelope deliberately permits degenerate collision half extents; CityPlotBounds requires positive occupied dimensions and has a different f64 containment/tolerance policy. Reusing it here would change the native algorithm. Canonical checked point/extents/orientation leaves are reused instead.
The existing 1.5+4.0 metre apron is represented by its exact 5.5 metre clearance; geometry, order, seeds and literal fixture inputs are retained.
The batch filter temporarily holds a second obstacle vector during admission. There is no partial mutation on failure.
Removing the identity height rewrite replaces its opaque failure with canonical terrain validation; ordinary valid heights are unchanged. Invalid preparation is an explicit error.

changes.trace: The caller passes its SceneTerrain instead of separately forwarding width, depth and spacing already stored in that terrain. The builder reads the canonical grid metadata internally; obstacle spacing remains the distinct serialized source-grid decoding input.
changes.preservation: The source creates coarse via from_heightmap(width,depth,spacing,heights) immediately before this call. Checked construction establishes the same metadata; no numeric conversion or random sampling changes. Seven inputs replace ten, allowing removal of the existing too_many_arguments allow. The result uses SceneInputResult.

changes.trace: Image and SceneElevationRange are private, closing independent record construction. Its three existing consumers obtain the checked range before consuming the image at Assets<Image>::add. The cached image/range record was already private.
changes.coverage: Weather, tree residency and tactical viewer consumers were inspected. No new tests were added.

changes.trace: Dir3 now reaches the slope calculation and scree coverage helpers directly. Raw-vector projection occurs inside the existing rotation calculation; the prior native try_normalize remains. Scree accesses direction components inside its unchanged noise calculation.
changes.preservation: Production adds no normalization. Two existing fixture normal literals now use checked direction admission instead of raw normalize. Exact source fragments are bound in P06-normal-and-query-source-comparisons.json; fixture runtime behavior is not yet verified.

changes.trace: The classifier produces FollowFloor or RaiseOnly. That enum remains intact through airborne clearance and floor application; only an actual conditional uses its permits_descent predicate. No bool-to-enum reconstruction is placed at intermediate consumers.
changes.preservation: The exact existing classifier condition and short-circuit order are source-compared. Seven literal fixture policy arguments preserve their old false/true choices. Existing assertions query the policy predicate; no cases or assertions were added.

reconciliation.interpretation: All historical application-entry files are now changed or responsibility-relocated, but file participation is not proof of closure. The fourteen unchanged files belong to architectural floor/gate profiles, native affine triangle clipping and already-typed profile owners, with associated existing tests. Their native height computations do not flatten a SceneTerrain support hit.
actual_receivers_examined: SceneTerrain sampled/owned query and property-support forwarders
Foot-clearance combined sole/toe calculation and run-reach callback bodies
Strategic SceneDocument validation, retained errors, venue preparation before command publication
Player spawn checked record through spawn_connected_player and its command boundary
Canonical native triangle/profile owners underlying unchanged query references
pending: Complete current caller/forwarder/fixture reconciliation for all P06 paths, not merely historical search hits.
Complete the remaining presentation/viewer/dispatcher cross-module source review and both final Code/Rule passes.
Check module ordering and official no-growth results across the final diff.
Publish only source-complete P06, then use hosted-only gates, fourteen new existing selections and exact-head artifact verification.
No complete getter audit or P06 acceptance is claimed. P08-P20 remain unfinished.
